note: LRRC7 variants cause intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 77, and case reports confirm seizures (including tonic seizures) as part of the neurodevelopmental phenotype.

evidence.text: LRRC7 is established as the causative gene for autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 77, supporting its role as a neurodevelopmental disease gene.

source.title: How Studying Rare Disease Leads to Mechanistic Insights and Therapeutic Development: Lessons from Nonmammalian Models

evidence.text: Individuals with pathogenic LRRC7 involvement present with neurodevelopmental phenotypes including global developmental delay and tonic seizures.
